_readme: Stay merge file: changes made in GitHub that the library export applies on top of the library on every publish.
Use it for exceptions only. The library (Stay Studio) stays the main source; fix the record there when you can.
Each entry: the stay's slug, the fields to set, and a note saying who and why. Allowed fields:
name, tagline, hero, gallery (replaces the gallery), galleryAdd (adds to it), bestMonths, bestMonthsNote,
coords ('lat, lng'), airport, airportDirections, hide (true keeps the page off the site).
Photos must be on res.cloudinary.com or media.base44.com. Founder stamps, facts and FAQs are never set here.
Saving this file on main runs the library sync, so the change goes live in about 5 minutes.
